title: system_data_generator
summary: A collection of scripts that train generative models to produce synthetic CPU, network, and memory usage samples for systems, loading a saved model and generating usage data. The pipeline directly imports and calls the standalone ctgan package's CTGANSynthesizer to train and sample this system telemetry data.
